arguments.value: Mark E. Fuller is a former United States District Judge for the Middle District of Alabama who served from 2002 to 2015, including as chief judge from 2004 to 2011. Born in Enterprise, Alabama, in 1958, he earned a B.S. from the University of Alabama in 1982 and a J.D. from the University of Alabama School of Law in 1985. Before joining the federal bench, he practiced law privately in Alabama, served as chief assistant district attorney for the Twelfth Judicial Circuit, and later as district attorney for the same circuit from 1997 to 2002.
